mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,member_id,channel,endpoint_hash,authorized,authorized_time,expires_at,revoked_time FROM dms_message_recipient_authorization WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND member_id=#{memberId} AND channel=#{channel} AND authorized=1 AND revoked_time IS NULL AND (expires_at IS NULL OR expires_at > #{now}) LIMIT 1
